page.layout: One page of text, in a single column. Heading "DEDICATIO." at the top, centred. Running text below it. At the foot, a signature "* 3" at left and a catchword at right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: DEDICATIO.
main_text.p: Ministerio sacratum voluit Filium suum p.m. Amis. Væ. Fratrem majorem natu EZECHIELEM, cujus præ-matura fata etiamnum lu-get Ecclesia. Hunc in O-rientalibus linguis Auditorem habuisse mihi olim contigit, & quidem suo merito primæ admissionis. Nihil enim intermittebat egregius Juvenis eorum, quibus eximiam in hoc stu-dii genere probaret indu-striam; usque eo, ut anno

page.notes: The catchword is printed as the old form cIↄ, which is M, and is set at the right below the last line. The "is" in "Amis" and the "æ" in "Væ" are superscript in the print. The signature "* 3" is at the foot, left of the catchword.
